name: Inspect helmd command
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
ls -l /usr/bin/helmd /usr/lib/python-exec/python3.12/python3 2>/dev/null || true
file /usr/bin/helmd 2>/dev/null || true
for arg in '' '--version' '-h' 'help' 'restart'; do echo "--- helmd $arg"; timeout 5 /usr/bin/helmd $arg 2>&1 | head -40 || true; done
REMOTE
description: Determine what the available Whatbox helmd restart command controls before invoking it.
